children: Finance leader takes charge of core finance transformation, with focus on automation, connected data and AI-enabled processes

Atul Kakade has been appointed Director of Finance – Core Finance AI-Enabled Transformation at Intuit, moving into a role focused on modernising finance processes through intelligent automation, connected data and technology-led transformation.

Kakade’s new mandate includes driving Intuit’s “Plan to Perform” transformation, aimed at strengthening finance processes and supporting data-led decision-making. His responsibilities cover the use of AI and automation to improve finance operations and help the function contribute to business performance.
The appointment adds to Kakade’s experience across finance transformation, enterprise applications, cloud technology and business operations.
Before joining Intuit, Kakade was Senior Director – Accounting Operations & AI Transformation at DocuSign, where he worked on finance and accounting process transformation.

His responsibilities included initiatives across Quote-to-Cash, revenue, tax, controllership and international expansion. He also worked on automation, AI-enabled financial reporting and reconciliation involving multiple data sources.
Kakade joined DocuSign in 2022 after nearly five years at Deloitte Consulting.

At Deloitte Consulting, Kakade served as Specialist Leader – Enterprise Applications Cloud Transformation. He worked on technology-led business process transformation involving cloud ERP across Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay and Record-to-Report functions.

His earlier career includes more than six years at Cisco, where he held roles in business operations and transformation. His work there covered digital transformation, programme management and enterprise systems, including a global Oracle ERP migration.
He also held leadership roles at Zensar Technologies, including Associate Vice President – Oracle ERP, working on finance systems, ordering and billing processes.

Kakade’s career has increasingly centred on the intersection of finance, technology and transformation. His experience spans Oracle ERP, cloud transformation, automation, enterprise applications and AI-enabled finance operations.
He holds an MBA in Global Management from the University of Phoenix and completed an executive programme in Digital Transformation at the University of California, Berkeley.
The Intuit appointment places this experience within a finance leadership role focused on the continued integration of AI and automation into core finance processes.
